metadata.name: Veil
metadata.description: Veil is a sophisticated collection of tools and utilities designed to facilitate advanced rendering for Minecraft mod developers. Our goal is to enable more modern game-engine level content in Java Minecraft, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in modding.
